failure_reasons: UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_PRECISION: frozen 1e-6 Hz tolerance not independently validated

capture.lock_time_definition: earliest beginning of a terminal sustained sequence of at least hold_blocks valid blocks; initial-condition and window conditional
capture.change_evidence: outputs/capture_02/02_nominal_high/fine: terminal -8 integer cycles, zero wrapped phase error, zero tail clamps and nominal frequency; v1.0 false negative

frequency_response.fit: least squares offset + trend + sin/cos at f,2f,3f; complex output divided-phase / input reference-phase
frequency_response.BW_definition: unique downward |T|=1/sqrt(2) crossing normalized to ideal DC divided-phase tracking gain; require low-frequency measured gain within 3 percent of unity
frequency_response.PM_prototype: conditional L_ident=T/(1-T) from measured complex fundamental T; no direct return-ratio injection, sampled harmonic coupling not validated; diagnostic estimate only
frequency_response.reuse_rule: existing raw waveforms and unchanged response extraction may be reused with provenance; new points only from measured brackets
